system.description: The character moves from one universe to another.
system.effect: The character instantly moves from their current universe to another universe. For instance: from Earth-616 to Earth-65. When they move to the other universe, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.

outcomes.label: Move the character to a previously visited place in another universe. Otherwise, use the closest available corresponding space. Scene selection and token placement remain Narrator-controlled.
